title: East coast terrace and promenade detail
caption: The terrace gains a readable vending display and fitted stone and drainage details; low planting groups finish the promenade verge. This is a bounded finish pass on the existing coast, with navigation and scene positions preserved. Matched afternoon samples: terrace draw calls 130→136 desktop and 56→61 phone; promenade 126→128 desktop and 52→55 phone. Median frame time stayed 16.7 ms in these short 92–93-frame captures; this is not a sustained performance benchmark. No performance budgets changed.

sections.title: Matched afternoon baseline
sections.caption: Existing terrace and promenade at the same positions and afternoon lighting used for comparison.

sections.title: First pass
sections.caption: Early terrace detailing and isolated verge plants. Superseded by grouped planting fitted around the existing lamps.

sections.title: Final afternoon views
sections.caption: Stocked vending display, fitted stone faces and joints, flush drainage, and small planted verge groups. Existing paths, benches and trees stay in place.

sections.title: First evening input check
sections.caption: Preserved harness attempt: scenery loaded, but the frozen capture simulation prevented the walking assertion.

sections.title: Second evening input check
sections.caption: Preserved harness attempt before enabling real-time simulation in capture mode. No different scenery revision.

sections.title: Final evening views and walking
sections.caption: Normal evening lighting and real native click-to-walk along the promenade, on desktop and phone. Both players reached the target on walkable paving.
